title: Exact Determination of the Binary Covering-Sequence Length L(12,3)
description: Technical report, exhaustive-search software, and source-bound evidence establishing L(12,3) = 36. Independent C++ and Rust traversals exclude all 68,719,476,734 binary sequences of positive lengths 1 through 35 through 506,526,514 rotation-reversal-complement representatives. A public attributed 36-bit witness is independently verified. Project-original material is MIT licensed; the normalized attributed witness remains under Apache-2.0.
notes: The MIT license applies to project-original material. The attributed fixture data/baseline-36.txt remains under Apache-2.0, with its source commit, hashes, modification, and license recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
